note: An example so the factory has something to make on day one. Asset Forge replaces this with the project's real list (see the content-factory-max skill).

groups.title: Interface icons
groups.intro: The buttons and pickups. Readable at 32 pixels, on a see-through ground.
groups.style: House style for Space Snacks icons: one bold, chunky cartoon object, thick dark outline, bright candy colours, soft top light, centred, on a fully transparent background. No text, no border, no shadow patch.

images.name: Heart (a life)
images.prompt: A glossy red heart, slightly squashed like a gummy sweet, with a white highlight.

images.name: Star (a point)
images.prompt: A five-pointed golden star, puffy like a marshmallow, a tiny smile.
images.alt: A puffy golden star with a tiny smile.

images.name: Pause button
images.prompt: Two rounded vertical bars side by side, mint green, like two sticks of gum.
images.alt: A pause button: two mint-green bars.

groups.title: Enemies
groups.style: House style for Space Snacks enemies: one cute-menacing snack creature, seen from the front, full body inside the frame with clear space around it, chunky cartoon, thick dark outline, bright candy colours, on a fully transparent background. No text, no ground.

jobs.title: Wave one, batch of three
jobs.batch:
The first three enemies in Space Snacks, a game where a hungry astronaut defends a lunchbox in orbit.

1. A jelly blob: a wobbly lime jelly with two googly eyes and a grumpy mouth.
2. A crisp drone: a single potato crisp flying on tiny rotor blades, one red eye.
3. A sprinkle crab: a pink doughnut with sprinkles, walking on six candy-stick legs.

They should look like one set: the same outline weight and the same light.

groups.title: Backgrounds
groups.style: House style for Space Snacks backgrounds: wide painted space scene, soft candy-coloured nebulae, a few distant planets that look like sweets, calm in the middle where the game is played. No text, no characters.

images.name: Level 1: the lunchbox orbit
images.prompt: Low orbit over a blue planet, a giant shiny lunchbox floating in the distance, gentle pink nebula.
images.alt: A shiny lunchbox floating in orbit over a blue planet, under a pink nebula.

images.name: Level 2: the candy belt
images.prompt: An asteroid belt made of boiled sweets and wrapped toffees, warm orange light from a nearby sun.
images.alt: An asteroid belt of boiled sweets and toffees in warm orange light.

groups.title: Sounds
groups.intro: Effects, a voice line and a loop of music. Practice makes free placeholder beeps for all of them; the Sound Stage plugs in real makers.
groups.style: Space Snacks sound: bright, bouncy, cartoon sci-fi, short and punchy, no harsh highs.

images.name: Pick up a star
images.prompt: A sparkly rising chime, like biting into a sugar star.
images.caption: [A sparkly chime]

images.name: Jelly blob squish
images.prompt: A wet, wobbly squish with a little boing at the end.
images.caption: [A jelly squishes and boings]

images.name: Orbit theme (loop)
images.prompt: A bouncy chiptune loop with a warm bass line, happy and a little cheeky.
images.caption: [Bouncy chiptune music]
